suite: World View V1 Field Dataset / Field Revision Descriptor Validation Vectors
registry: P2-09-30 V1 Built-in Field Descriptor Registry V0.1
status: design fixtures; not executed against implementation. FDV-004/005 and FDV-009 require Manifest V2 semantics; the original Manifest V1 cannot express the required unit, vertical reference or coordinate precision-profile pin.

cases.case: Create the first Map-owned elevation Dataset with a supported descriptor and valid manifest.
Create the first Map-owned land_water Dataset with registered categories and valid manifest.
Create a Field Dataset using an unregistered field_key.
Publish elevation without a required unit.
Publish elevation without a stable vertical_reference_id.
Publish NaN, positive infinity or negative infinity as a numeric field value.
Treat no-data as numeric zero or sea level without an explicit valid-data declaration.
Use a missing, malformed or Map Space-incompatible spatial_reference_id.
Omit coverage, resolution_profile or grid_alignment from the canonical manifest.
Publish partial coverage when the exact coverage and outside-coverage behavior are explicitly declared.
Use an unregistered category such as marsh_unknown without a descriptor revision.
Collapse unknown, no-data and outside_coverage into one indistinguishable value.
Treat outside_coverage as water or infer coastline solely from the coverage edge.
Retain land, water, unknown and outside_coverage as distinct registered states; keep no-data separate.
Create two authoritative Datasets for the same (Map, field_key).
Create the same field_key in two different Maps with distinct Dataset identities.
Point a Dataset current_field_revision_id to a revision owned by another Dataset.
Publish a revision with an expected current revision that is stale.
Publish the next monotonic immutable revision using compare-and-swap against the current revision.
Mutate or delete a published Field Revision or overwrite its published Asset bytes.
Reference a missing or cross-Project Core Asset from a Field Revision.
Two Maps reuse identical immutable Asset bytes while retaining separate Dataset identities and current pointers.
Publish a new revision in Map A; every Branch and Historical Time context in Map A resolves the new current baseline.
Publish a new revision in Map A; Map B remains unchanged even when its Dataset references the same content-addressed Asset.
Submit a Branch-local Field Dataset override or historical-time-specific Field Revision in V1.
Represent a baseline correction as a post-zero Command, Event or State Change.
Expose staged editor/AI field content as formally published before Core Domain confirms the transaction.
Treat a Derived Artifact as a formal source field without explicit adoption of the exact bytes.
Adopt a Derived Artifact explicitly, retaining exact source artifact identity, hash and transformation provenance in the new Field Revision.
Fail the SQLite publication transaction after Asset file publication; leave no revision/pointer commit and reconcile the file as an orphan.
Invalidate only dependent calculations and Checkpoints across all Branches/Times of the owning Map after a new current revision.
Reuse a Checkpoint whose relevant Field Baseline fingerprint no longer matches the current Dataset revision.

manifest_compatibility.legacy_v1: Existing published V1 revisions remain readable; missing semantic values are explicitly unavailable and must not be inferred.
manifest_compatibility.new_publication: New formal Field Revision publication uses Manifest V2.
manifest_compatibility.resolution_profile: Represented by grid.spacing_x, grid.spacing_y, grid.width and grid.height.
manifest_compatibility.grid_alignment: Represented by grid.origin_x, grid.origin_y, grid.axis_orientation and grid.cell_registration.
manifest_compatibility.coordinate_precision: Pinned by spatial.coordinate_precision_profile_id and resolved through the immutable Spatial Reference definition.
